meta.rule: permanently free + commercial use OK; licence quote + URL recorded per source and per image

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A (Copernicus) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.revisit: 5 d nominal (2A/2B/2C), 2-3 d at overlap latitudes
sources.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice (EU Reg. 1159/2013): free, full and open; reproduction/distribution/modification allowed, no commercial restriction; credit 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data <year>'
sources.licence_quote: users shall have a free, full and open access to Copernicus Sentinel Data
sources.access: STAC https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1 collection sentinel-2-l2a; anonymous SAS signing, no key
sources.used_for: latest clear true-colour + NDVI clip (block +300 m), 24-month monthly NDVI/brightness series

sources.name: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 via Planetary Computer
sources.licence: USGS Landsat: no restrictions (US Government public domain)
sources.licence_quote: There are no restrictions on Landsat data downloaded from the USGS
sources.access: PC STAC collection landsat-c2-l2 (keyless); also USGS M2M/EarthExplorer (free login)

sources.name: NASA HLS v2 S30 + L30 (Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2)
sources.licence: CC0 (NASA ESDIS default for NASA-led mission data)
sources.licence_quote: data provided from a NASA-led mission are licensed as Creative Commons Zero (CC0)
sources.access: PC STAC collections hls2-s30 / hls2-l30 keyless; LP DAAC CMR-STAC needs a free Earthdata login (not used)

tested.note: scene search per block via PC (no Earthdata login needed)

sources.name: Sentinel-1 RTC (radiometric terrain corrected) via Planetary Computer
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Planetary Computer Sentinel-1 RTC; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data)

sources.name: NAIP (USDA FSA) via Planetary Computer
sources.licence: Public domain with attribution (USDA FSA NAIP)
sources.used_for: catalogue of years (another lane renders img/<year>.jpg)

sources.name: Metropolitan Council / MnGeo Twin Cities 7-county spring leaf-off orthos
sources.licence: Public domain (Minnesota Government Data Practices Act)
sources.licence_quote: This dataset is public domain under the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act

sources.name: TxGIO StratMap 2020 Capital Area leaf-off orthos
DRAPP 2022 Denver regional leaf-off orthos (State of Colorado on AWS)
sources.revisit: 2 yr (DRAPP); 2024 not yet in open bucket
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 (State of Colorado public imagery, AWS Open Data registry)

sources.name: NOAA NGS Emergency Response Imagery (storms.ngs.noaa.gov)
sources.licence: US Government public domain (NOAA NGS Emergency Response Imagery)
sources.licence_quote: open to the public and can be used as desired
sources.access: per-event https://storms.ngs.noaa.gov/storms/<event>/services/index.json (bounds + XYZ tiles); raw tiles s3://noaa-eri-pds
sources.filter: layers attributed MAXAR (CC BY-NC) or CAP (licence not stated) are excluded

tested.note: 30 event indexes read; 49 layers within 25 km of a block

sources.name: OpenAerialMap (HOT OIN catalogue)
sources.licence: per image; kept only CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA / CC0

tested.note: 3064 open-licence images within 25 km across all blocks
